Build the resolver that locates the file for the project under test, runs its declared enforcement command, and - when no such file exists - emits NOT-CHECKED and surfaces it, rather than folding the absence into a silent pass or blocking a project that was never coverage-gated. Both failure directions are live: a hardcoded command from another project is a dead command here.
